units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 28:37">Targ. Ex. XXVIII, 37</cite>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="V00543"><he>תִּכְלָא</he> III</cite>.—

Men. 42ᵇ הא ת׳ היכא וכ׳ how do you dye the blue wool for the show-fringes? Ib. 39ᵃ sq. האי גברא … כולה ת׳ ורמי לה וכ׳ a man wore a cloak all of blue wool, and had show-threads of blue wool, but they were entirely plaited (leaving no fringes); יאי גלימא לא יאי ת׳ the cloak is becoming, but the show-fringe is not becoming (is not according to prescription); a. e.—Trnsf. the choice of purity of descent.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:8">Gen. R. s. 37</cite>, end <he>חבל ימא ת׳ דבבל וכ׳</he> the Sea District (v. <cite ref="H00064"><he>חֲבֵיל</he></cite>) is the choice of Babylonia &c.; <cite ref="Kiddushin 72a:3">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite>; Y. ib. IV, 65ᵈ top.
